notes.subject: diphapo
notes.rationale: כליות ke diphapo tša nnete; go swana le pelo, ke legaê la maikutišano go Seheberu — e sego feela leswe la mmele

notes.subject: e baba
notes.rationale: יתחמץ: 'go baba/go ferementeja' (JPS 'in a ferment') kgahlanong le KJV 'grieved' (go hlohloga)

notes.subject: אשתונן
notes.rationale: 'o nthunta/o ntheka ka go šišinyega' — שנן go bolela go thunya/go hlaba; kgetho ya bobedi: 'ke a iphiša'

translation: Ge pelo ya ka e baba, gomme diphapo tša ka di nthunta
